sources.dataVintage: outlines from a 2011 flyover, updated periodically from aerial imagery and LiDAR; elevation fields are named *_2010
sources.licenceEvidence: The Analyze Boston record for this dataset states the licence verbatim as 'Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License (PDDL)' AND lists this exact FeatureServer URL as one of its resources. The service's OWN metadata is empty: copyrightText '', serviceDescription '', description '', no licenseInfo. The licence therefore attaches by the City's own naming of the resource, not by publisher identity.
sources.crs: EPSG:6492 (NAD83(2011) / Massachusetts Mainland, ftUS); service reports wkid 103072 / latestWkid 6492, xyUnits 3048.0060960121928
sources.verticalDatum: UNRESOLVED — elevation fields are in feet and the vertical reference is not stated by the service
knownLimitations: The unit is the ROOF-BREAK PART, not the building: 207 of 218 parts (95.0%) share an edge with another part, and the median part is 146.66 m2. A dissolve step is required before this can feed any building-level consumer.

returnCountOnly reports 220 for the same envelope while outSR=4326 returns 218. The two extra features lie marginally outside the box and are admitted only when the spatial test runs in the native CRS. Boundary tangency, not data loss.
Per-feature edit dates are effectively absent: the Added field is populated on 1 of 218 features.

transform.canonicalPath: EPSG:6492 --[ArcGIS query outSR=4326]--> WGS84 lat/lon --[src/core/Geo.js geo()]--> Boston local X/Z
transform.verification: An independent inverse Lambert Conformal Conic implemented in research/gis-stage1a/transform.mjs was run over all 4,575 shared vertices of the native EPSG:6492 fetch and compared against the server's own outSR=4326 output. Radial residual: min 0.9708 m, median 0.9709 m, max 0.9710 m; sd 0.00003 m north / 0.00004 m east. The near-zero scatter verifies the server reprojection; the constant 0.971 m (mean dNorth -0.9698, dEast +0.0464) is the NAD83-to-WGS84 datum difference, which the check deliberately omits so that it is isolated rather than hidden.
transform.knownSystematic: A ~0.97 m NAD83/WGS84 datum offset, essentially all in northing, is present in every coordinate in the fixture and is smaller than every other quantity measured in Stage 1A.
